in_sanskrit.name: सोरव
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has the power to destroy like a thunderbolt, or one who is powerful like water.

in_hindi.name: सोरव
in_hindi.meaning: सोर (सोराकार, the god of thunder) + व (वारण, the god of water)
in_hindi.long_meaning: Name of a powerful deity who holds the power of both thunder and water.

in_tamil.name: சோரவ
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who possesses the power of thunder and water.

in_telugu.name: శోరవ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who holds the power of both thunder and water.

in_marathi.name: Sorav
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sorav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sorav is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sor' which means 'Sun' and 'Av' which means 'Ray'. The name represents the brightness and warmth of the sun's rays.
